mapper.select: SELECT * FROM USERS WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND account_status != 'DELETED'
SELECT * FROM USERS WHERE user_email = #{email} AND account_status != 'DELETED'
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM USERS WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM USERS WHERE user_email = #{email}
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM USERS WHERE nickname = #{nickname}
SELECT user_id FROM USERS WHERE user_email = #{email} AND email_verified = TRUE AND account_status != 'DELETED' LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE USERS SET user_password = #{encodedPassword}, password_enabled= TRUE WHERE user_idx = #{userIdx}
UPDATE USERS SET user_password = NULL, password_enabled = FALSE, email_login_enabled = FALSE WHERE user_idx = #{userIdx}
UPDATE USERS SET user_email = #{email}, email_verified = #{emailVerified}, email_login_enabled = FALSE WHERE user_idx = #{userIdx}
UPDATE USERS SET user_password = #{encodedPassword}, password_enabled = TRUE WHERE user_idx = #{userIdx}
UPDATE USERS u SET is_verified_member = CASE WHEN u.email_verified = TRUE OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM USER_SOCIAL s WHERE s.user_idx = u.user_idx) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END WHERE u.user_idx = #{userIdx}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM USERS WHERE account_status = 'ACTIVE' AND COALESCE(last_login_at, created_at) <= #{cutoff}
mapper.update: UPDATE USERS SET account_status = 'DORMANT', dormant_at = NOW(), dormant_release_required = TRUE, status_changed_at = NOW() WHERE user_idx = #{userIdx} AND account_status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE USERS SET account_status = 'ACTIVE', dormant_at = NULL, dormant_release_required = FALSE, status_changed_at = NOW(), last_login_at = NOW() WHERE user_idx = #{userIdx}
UPDATE USERS SET account_status = 'ACTIVE', blocked_until = NULL, blocked_reason = NULL, status_changed_at = NOW() WHERE user_idx = #{userIdx}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_SOCIAL (user_idx, provider, provider_user_id) VALUES (#{userIdx}, #{provider}, #{providerUserId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM USER_SOCIAL WHERE user_idx = #{userIdx} AND provider = #{provider}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_LOGIN_HISTORY ( user_idx, event_type, auth_type, auth_provider, auth_flow, login_method, login_identifier, session_id, request_uri, logout_callback_uri, request_id, flow_trace_id, is_success, fail_reason, ip_address, user_agent ) VALUES ( #{userIdx}, #{eventType}, #{authType}, #{authProvider}, #{authFlow}, #{loginMethod}, #{loginIdentifier}, #{sessionId}, #{requestUri}, #{logoutCallbackUri}, #{requestId}, #{flowTraceId}, #{success}, #{failReason}, #{ipAddress}, #{userAgent} )
mapper.update: UPDATE EMAIL_VERIFICATION_REQUEST SET status = 'CANCELLED', cancelled_at = NOW() WHERE user_idx = #{userIdx} AND purpose = #{purpose} AND status IN ('REQUESTED', 'VERIFIED') AND applied_at IS NULL AND cancelled_at IS NULL
UPDATE EMAIL_VERIFICATION_REQUEST SET status = 'CANCELLED', cancelled_at = NOW() WHERE email_verification_request_idx = #{emailVerificationRequestIdx}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM EMAIL_VERIFICATION_REQUEST WHERE token = #{token} AND purpose = #{purpose} AND status = 'REQUESTED' AND expired_at > NOW() AND applied_at IS NULL AND cancelled_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE EMAIL_VERIFICATION_REQUEST SET status = 'VERIFIED', verified_at = NOW() WHERE email_verification_request_idx = #{emailVerificationRequestIdx}
UPDATE EMAIL_VERIFICATION_REQUEST SET status = 'APPLIED', applied_at = NOW() WHERE email_verification_request_idx = #{emailVerificationRequestIdx}
UPDATE EMAIL_VERIFICATION SET used = TRUE, used_at = NOW() WHERE verify_idx = #{verifyIdx}
UPDATE EMAIL_VERIFICATION SET cancelled_at = NOW(), expired_at = CASE WHEN expired_at > NOW() THEN NOW() ELSE expired_at END WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND used = FALSE AND cancelled_at IS NULL
